producer_report.summary: Added `inventory` in crates/athena-cap-study/src/prompts_inventory.rs. It is a pure, sorted, deterministic list of the instruction files a study cites, with the claim and card ids that cite each. It names no instance. A new test, crates/athena-cap-study/tests/prompt_inventory.rs, runs it twice on every real studies/<id>/ and checks the output is non-empty and identical. It also checks the OLY-B-S2-01 spec entry and has negative cases. Updated the spec entry, CHANGELOG.md and xtask/shard-timings.txt. I did not run the full `cargo test`; fmt and the full-suite test are left to Athena's checks.

checks_run.note: 43 unit tests and 5 prompt_inventory tests pass

criteria_check.criterion: docs/spec.toml entry OLY-B-S2-01 has mechanism naming an existing code path and test file (not "none"), owner "Athena", and a measure that names the test command and ends with `status: not shown`.
criteria_check.evidence: docs/spec.toml OLY-B-S2-01 mechanism cites crates/athena-cap-study/src/prompts_inventory.rs and crates/athena-cap-study/tests/prompt_inventory.rs; owner Athena; measure names `cargo test -p athena-cap-study --test prompt_inventory` and ends `status: not shown`. Test the_spec_entry_has_the_mechanism_owner_and_measure checks it.

criteria_check.criterion: The diff adds a prompt-surface inventory function in crates/athena-cap-study/src that names no instance id, and the mechanism text in docs/spec.toml cites its path.
criteria_check.evidence: `inventory` in crates/athena-cap-study/src/prompts_inventory.rs; cargo test -p athena-core --test study_instance_split passes (the_study_capability_names_no_instance); mechanism cites the path.

criteria_check.criterion: A new test runs the inventory twice over every real studies/<id>/ directory, asserts non-empty identical output, and asserts the spec entry has a real mechanism, the owner and the measure label. Run `cargo test` and check the test passes. The test must fail on a spec entry with mechanism "none" or an empty inventory (negative cases in the same test file).
criteria_check.evidence: cargo test -p athena-cap-study --test prompt_inventory: 5 pass, including every_studied_instance_has_a_reproducible_non_empty_inventory, a_none_mechanism_is_refused, a_wrong_owner_or_measure_is_refused, an_empty_inventory_is_detected. The test is in athena-cap-study/tests because athena-core cannot depend on that crate. Unit test a_study_citing_no_instruction_file_gives_an_empty_inventory is in prompts_inventory.rs.
